description: Use this to read one of the documents returned by search, given its id. Returns the full text and the URL to cite. For an offer: price, previous price, pack size, price per kg or litre, chain, validity, and the same product in the other chains' current flyers. For a flyer: validity, number of offers and biggest discounts. For a product: this week's typical and lowest flyer price, the trend and each chain. Ids come only from search. Covers Italy only.

id.description: The id of a document returned by search.

url.description: The page to cite, on prezzinvista.it
